    window.openReportModal = function (params) {
        if (preventReportModal) return;

        var flagFor   = params.flagFor   || 'video';
        var itemId    = params.itemId    !== undefined ? params.itemId : '';
        var isSfw     = params.isSfw     || false;
        var isMppCpp  = params.isMppCpp  || false;
        var submitUrl = params.submitUrl || null;
        var onFlagged = params.onFlagged || null;

        var config = REPORT_FLAG_MODAL_CONFIG;
        var el     = document.querySelector('v-flag-modal');
        if (!el) return;

        function doOpen() {
            var trans = Object.assign({}, config.baseTranslations, config.translationOverrides[flagFor] || {});

            var types;
            if (flagFor === 'user') {
                types = isMppCpp ? config.flagTypes.user.mppCpp : config.flagTypes.user.regular;
            } else {
                types = config.flagTypes[flagFor] || [];
            }

            var url = submitUrl !== null
                ? submitUrl
                : (config.submitUrls[flagFor] || '').replace('__ID__', itemId);

            el.setAttribute('translation', JSON.stringify(trans).replace(/'/g, '&#39;'));
            el.setAttribute('flag-for',    flagFor);
            el.setAttribute('flag-types',  JSON.stringify(types).replace(/'/g, '&#39;'));
            el.setAttribute('item-id',     String(itemId));
            el.setAttribute('submit-url',  url);
            el.setAttribute('is-sfw',      isSfw ? '1' : '0');
            el.setAttribute('platform',    config.platform);
            el.setAttribute('loggedin',    String(config.loggedIn));

            if (onFlagged) {
                el.addEventListener('flagged', function handler(e) {
                    el.removeEventListener('flagged', handler);
                    onFlagged(e);
                });
            }

            var instance = el.getVueInstance ? el.getVueInstance() : null;
            if (instance) {
                setTimeout(function () { instance.open(); }, 100);
            } else {
                var script = document.createElement('script');
                script.onload = function () {
                    setTimeout(function () {
                        var inst = el.getVueInstance ? el.getVueInstance() : null;
                        if (inst) inst.open();
                    }, 100);
                };
                script.src = _vFlagModalSrc;
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            }
        }

        doOpen();
    };

    function loadThumbsLazyLoad() {
        var image = document.querySelectorAll('.js-preload'),
            thumbToUse = 'data-mediumthumb';

        for (var i = 0; i < image.length; i++) {
            var itemsCount  = image[i];

            if (itemsCount.src != itemsCount.getAttribute(thumbToUse)) {
                itemsCount.src = itemsCount.getAttribute(thumbToUse);
            }

            if (i == 10) {
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    loadThumbsLazyLoad();

    // Thumbnail fetching:
    function loadThumbs() {
        var image = document.querySelectorAll('.js-preload'),
            thumbToUse = 'data-mediumthumb';
        for (var i = 0; i < image.length; i++) {
            var itemsCount = image[i];
            if (itemsCount.getAttribute(thumbToUse)) {
                if (itemsCount.src != itemsCount.getAttribute(thumbToUse)) {
                    itemsCount.src = itemsCount.getAttribute(thumbToUse);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    function initializeV3Captcha() {
        var promise = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
            // CRITICAL FIX (PH-133249 caused token reuse bug):
            // Always clear existing tokens before generating new ones
            // reCAPTCHA tokens are single-use and CANNOT be reused
            if (captchaToken) {
                captchaToken.value = '';
            }
            var existingTokens = document.querySelectorAll('.js_captcha_token');
            existingTokens && [].forEach.call(existingTokens, function(el) {
                el.value = '';
            });
            
            // KEEP PH-133249 logic: If checkbox captcha exists on page (like CPP), skip v3
            // Google doesn't support multiple site keys on same page
            if (
                hasPageCheckboxCaptcha()
                && typeof window.grecaptcha === "object"
                && window.grecaptcha.enterprise
                && typeof window.grecaptcha.enterprise.ready === 'function'
            ) {
                console.log('Checkbox captcha already loaded on page - skipping v3 captcha initialization.');
                resolve('done');
                return;
            }
            
            // Check if grecaptcha.enterprise is fully loaded and ready
            if (typeof window.grecaptcha === "object" && window.grecaptcha.enterprise && typeof window.grecaptcha.enterprise.ready === 'function') {
                // Enterprise API is ready, execute immediately
                grecaptcha.enterprise.ready(function () {
                    grecaptcha.enterprise.execute('6LectvslAAAAAC51V1_hA5yWoPnhCvYbJaulh5Us', {action: 'add_comment'}).then(function (token) {
                        addingTokens(token);
                        resolve('done');
                    });
                });
            } else if (typeof window.grecaptcha === "object") {
                // grecaptcha exists but enterprise not ready yet - wait for it with interval check
                var checkInterval = setInterval(function() {
                    if (window.grecaptcha.enterprise && typeof window.grecaptcha.enterprise.ready === 'function') {
                        clearInterval(checkInterval);
                        grecaptcha.enterprise.ready(function () {
                            grecaptcha.enterprise.execute('6LectvslAAAAAC51V1_hA5yWoPnhCvYbJaulh5Us', {action: 'add_comment'}).then(function (token) {
                                addingTokens(token);
                                resolve('done');
                            });
                        });
                    }
                }, 50); // Check every 50ms
                
                // Timeout after 5 seconds to prevent infinite waiting
                setTimeout(function() {
                    clearInterval(checkInterval);
                    console.error('reCAPTCHA enterprise API failed to load within timeout for initializeV3Captcha');
                    reject('timeout');
                }, 5000);
            } else {
                // grecaptcha doesn't exist at all, load the script
                var head = document.getElementsByTagName('head')[0];
                var script = document.createElement('script');
                script.type = 'text/javascript';
                var scriptLoaded = false;
                
                script.onload = function () {
                    scriptLoaded = true;
                    grecaptcha.enterprise.ready(function () {
                        grecaptcha.enterprise.execute('6LectvslAAAAAC51V1_hA5yWoPnhCvYbJaulh5Us', {action: 'submit'}).then(function (token) {
                            addingTokens(token);
                            resolve('done');
                        }).catch(function(error) {
                            console.error('reCAPTCHA execute failed:', error);
                            reject('execute_failed');
                        });
                    });
                };
                
                script.onerror = function() {
                    console.error('Failed to load reCAPTCHA script');
                    reject('script_load_failed');
                };
                
                // Timeout protection for script loading
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (!scriptLoaded) {
                        console.error('reCAPTCHA script loading timeout');
                        reject('script_load_timeout');
                    }
                }, 10000); // 10 second timeout for script load
                
                script.src = 'https://www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js?render=6LectvslAAAAAC51V1_hA5yWoPnhCvYbJaulh5Us';
                head.appendChild(script);
            }
        });
        return promise;
    }

        captchaMultipleTokens && [].forEach.call(captchaMultipleTokens, function (el) {

        });
    }

<script>
    (function() {
        var supportsModernJS = true;
        try {
            // Check if the browser supports modern JavaScript
            new Function("(()=>{}), class Test {}, async function a() {}, (1n + 1n), globalThis;");
        } catch (e) {
            supportsModernJS = false;
        }

        if (!supportsModernJS) {
            var babelScript = document.createElement('script');
            babelScript.src = "https://ei.phncdn.com/www-static/js/lib/babel-7.22.10.min.js?cache=2026102205";
            babelScript.onload = function() {
                console.log("Babel loaded for older browsers.");
                transpileScripts(); // Transpile existing scripts immediately
                waitForLateScripts(10); // Start waiting for late-loading scripts
            };
            document.head.appendChild(babelScript);
        }

        function transpileScripts() {
            document.querySelectorAll("script[src]").forEach(script => {
                transpileSingleScript(script);
            });
        }

        function waitForLateScripts(attempts) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                var remainingScripts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("script[src]")).filter(script => !script.dataset.transpiled);

                if (remainingScripts.length > 0) {
                    console.log(`Waiting for late scripts... Remaining: ${remainingScripts.length}, Attempts left: ${attempts}`);
                    remainingScripts.forEach(script => transpileSingleScript(script));

                    if (attempts > 0) {
                        waitForLateScripts(attempts - 1); // Try again in 500ms
                    }
                } else {
                    console.log("No more late scripts detected. Stopping checks.");
                }
            }, 500);
        }

        function transpileSingleScript(script) {
            if (script.dataset.transpiled) return; // Skip already transpiled scripts

            fetch(script.src)
                .then(response => response.text())
                .then(code => {
                    var transpiledCode = Babel.transform(code, { presets: ["env"] }).code;
                    var newScript = document.createElement("script");
                    newScript.innerHTML = transpiledCode;
                    document.body.appendChild(newScript);
                    script.dataset.transpiled = "true"; // Mark script as transpiled
                    console.log(`Transpiled: ${script.src}`);
                })
                .catch(error => console.error(`Failed to transpile script: ${script.src}`, error));
        }
    })();
</script>
